name: Philippine Passport
description: Issued by the DFA for international travel and identity verification.

name: Philippine National ID (PhilSys)
description: The unified national identification card for all Filipinos.

name: Driver’s License (LTO)
description: Issued by the LTO as a license to drive and valid government ID.

name: SSS UMID Card
description: Multi-purpose ID issued by the Social Security System (SSS).

name: GSIS eCard
description: Government-issued ID for GSIS members, used for loans and benefits.

name: PRC ID
description: ID for licensed professionals, issued by the Professional Regulation Commission.

name: Postal ID
description: General-purpose ID issued by the Philippine Postal Corporation.

name: Voter’s ID
description: Issued by COMELEC to registered voters as proof of registration.

name: PhilHealth ID
description: Used for availing PhilHealth benefits in healthcare facilities.

name: TIN ID (with photo)
description: Issued by BIR for taxpayers. Must include a photo to be valid.

name: OWWA ID / OFW e-Card
description: Issued to OFWs as proof of OWWA membership and identity.

name: PWD ID
description: Issued to Persons With Disabilities for access to benefits and discounts.

name: Senior Citizen ID
description: Issued to citizens aged 60 and above to access senior discounts and benefits.

name: Company ID
description: Issued by the employer as proof of employment (valid if government-recognized).

name: Firearms License
description: Issued by PNP to licensed firearm holders, also serves as a government ID.

name: Indigenous People’s ID
description: Issued to members of indigenous groups by the NCIP.

name: Marina ID
description: Issued by MARINA to seafarers and maritime professionals.
